evidence.detail: rs/f/a owns the exact settings.properties path, plus the temporary-file/replace workflow used to persist the client settings file safely.
Its SaveSettings task writes the current static settings to disk with BufferedWriter, while the load path uses java.util.Properties to restore those values from settings.properties.

Surviving keys span client behavior and presentation, including oldschool_graphics, screen_mode, show_roofs, show_fog, item_drag, queued_item_clicks_v2, player_attack_option, npc_attack_option, desktop_notifications, timer_overlay, shift_drop and key_binding_<n>.

More than one hundred exact-v308 classes reference rs/f/a, including Client, cache/definition loaders, interface code, plugins, rendering, notification and shell code; the class is the shared global client-settings authority rather than a local feature helper.

candidates.note: ClientSettings is the conservative semantic name for the exact settings.properties-backed global client settings authority. It does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.
